newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu says may buy Alaska crude on term basis.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu says may buy Alaska crude on term basis.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Monday it may buy Alaskan North Slope (ANS) crude on a term basis as specifications of oil products made from ANS crude meet Japanese standards when it is blended with other crudes.
Idemitsu imported 1.3 million barrels of ANS crude from British Petroleum Co Plc on a trial basis in August.

A series of analyses on the import cargo showed the refiner can produce gas oil and kerosene with specifications clearing Japanese standards if the Alaskan crude is mixed with some other crudes, an Idemitsu spokesman said.
The oil firm would import ANS crude either on an annual term basis or on a spot basis if import costs were economically competitive against other crudes with similar quality, he said.
ANS is a heavy, 29.5 degree API (American Petroleum Institute) gravity crude with sulphur content of 1.05 percent.
Idemitsu, however, had no immediate plans to negotiate with British Petroleum on further imports of ANS crude, he added.
Cosmo Oil Co Ltd, the other Japanese refiner that has imported ANS crude on an experimental basis, said it may import the Alaskan crude again, but only on a spot basis.
